name: Quality Industrial Corp.
summary: Quality Industrial Corp. operates primarily as a provider of comprehensive data intelligence for businesses. The company currently manages Wikiprofile.com, an online platform offering detailed insights into companies, business professionals, and investors. Additionally, it is in the process of developing Wikifunding, a web-based service intended to expedite the matching process between startups and potential investors. QIND is also expanding its service offerings to include Wiki Business Profiles, a free basic listing that empowers professionals and businesses to elevate their online brand visibility and share pertinent corporate information. Another forthcoming service is Wiki Lead Generation, which will supply curated lead packages to enable users to construct thorough profiles of customers, prospects, investors, suppliers, and partners, thus fostering more informed decision-making. Finally, the company is creating Wiki Press Wire, a press release distribution service powered by AmpliFi. Initially named Wikisoft Corp., the organization officially rebranded to Quality Industrial Corp. in August 2022. Its corporate headquarters are located in San Francisco, California. As of May 28, 2022, Quality Industrial Corp. functions as a subsidiary of Emergency Response Technologies LLC.
